name: On the Other Side
summary: Tan'jani sends you to Camp Mojache in Feralas to seek help from Witch Doctor Uzer'i. Though known for his magic, Uzer'i is also a hunter.

sections.title: Tan'jani's Friend
sections.body: Across Feralas, Camp Mojache is where you can find Witch Doctor Uzer'i, an old friend of Tan'jani. Tan'jani says Uzer'i works with magic, but is also a hunter. You are sent to speak with him, leaving the wide open plains behind.

faq.answer: Tan'jani sends you to Witch Doctor Uzer'i, an old friend.
Witch Doctor Uzer'i is at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

faq.q: Why am I being sent to Uzer'i?
faq.answer: Tan'jani says Uzer'i is looking for help and asks you to speak with him.
Witch Doctor Uzer'i works with magic and is also a hunter.

attribution: In-game quest text: On the Other Side
